item.title: Nebuta Paper-Craft Workshop: Make a Lantern — Aomori Guide
item.description: The giant Nebuta floats are built from wire frames covered in painted washi paper and lit from within. In Aomori City workshops you can learn this craft in miniature — shaping wire, applying washi, and painting your own glowing mini Nebuta lantern to take home. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City, Aomori Hours By reservation Admission Workshop ~¥1,500 Time needed About 1 hour Best time Year-round What to Expect Build a mini washi-and-wire lantern.
